newsitem.title: USA: CHS Electronics says CFO exercises options.
newsitem.headline: CHS Electronics says CFO exercises options.

text.p: CHS Electronics said Monday its chief financial officer, Craig Toll, has recently taken a 20,000 share position in the company through the exercise of stock options.
The company said Toll exercised options to purchase 40,000 shares.
The company said he retained 20,000 of the shares and sold 20,000 shares, primarily to fund the purchase and pay income taxes on the sale, and for personal reasons.
The company said it has about 14,690,000 shares outstanding.
